title: Kodak’s next collectible is a tiny digital photo frame that doubles as a tracker
description: After expanding its Charmera collection with a Millennium Edition featuring Y2K-inspired designs earlier this year, Reto's follow-up to its tiny Kodak camera is an equally small digital photo frame you can use to display your shots. But while the Charmera's usefulness stopped at snapping grainy photos and terrible videos, the Kodak SlideTag goes one step […]
